summary: Medication Effectiveness summary now shows correct directional language per metric — and Advanced Analytics period buttons always stay highlighted.
fixes: Medication Effectiveness — Summary message now correctly distinguishes systolic and diastolic direction. Instead of a single ambiguous 'increased/decreased' label, it reads e.g. 'Systolic dropped 3 mmHg · Diastolic rose 1 mmHg.' Icon is ✅ when systolic and diastolic both dropped, ⚠️ when mixed, and 🔴 when both rose.

Advanced Analytics — Period buttons (7 Days / 30 Days / 90 Days / Custom) now reliably stay highlighted after selection. Previously, opening the Doctor's Report modal could silently clear the active state due to a shared DOM query. Both selectors are now fully independent.
